native_contract.selection: A real completed button0 selection requests the original NewGame branch. Button1/2/3 select Load/Config/Omake; button4 requests closing. No boot-time synthetic selection or forced variable flag is valid.
native_contract.final_frame: The native click-count frame is printed before FinalExitRoutine. A configured exit-screen capture therefore refers to that full Title frame, including buttons, rather than the last background-script-only frame.
native_contract.background: Selection first disables background-script mode. The original background context may be discarded at this explicit outer-mode boundary; this does not acknowledge an unknown native call or complete its remaining DRAW count.
native_contract.variables: The reviewed Legacy1000 InitNewGame clears [100,200) and [300,1000), then applies those same indices from the enabled original VarInit table. Persistent [200,300) is retained. Optional extension variable assignment follows initialization.
native_contract.effects: InitNewGame resets all16 eyes, layer-off and effect state. ClearAllEffect(FALSE) resets command/flags/picture assignment/rectangles/count, retaining the distinct picture-file cache and previous-effect metadata; it does not imply deleting every decoded picture resource.
native_contract.controller: Original control-script PC and stack pointer reset to0, script-run mode resets, and SetYoyaku schedules execution. It does not assign a made-up game-mode0 or directly jump to a named story script.
native_contract.state: Message-window/option/scene/skip/demo-related native state is reset by the reviewed initialization. Later source-only state such as expanded-variable or new subsystem hooks must not be imported silently.
native_contract.shared_boundary: Resource lifetime, immutable frame handles, retained layers/widgets, image composition and audio stay in CrySirror services. The adapter retains only native transition/parameter/reset/save policy.

validation.existing: Authored Title tests cover shared image composition, immutable generations, alpha-hit widgets and native clickTime; actual player31 reached native Title counter70 and then stopped at MOVE52.
not_claimed: Original Start selection or first story text
